Q2 uses a LEFT JOIN wrapped in a subquery, which includes all projects, even those without a matching employee (with NULL for EXPERIENCE_YEARS). The AVG function in Q2 will average in NULLs (which have no effect on AVG), but Q1 will not include such projects at all. This leads to different results when projects have no matching employee.
